note: Gurabo (72063) parcels are published by CRIM only as the Parcelario layer on catastro.crimpr.net, which requires a token (Token Required). The public CRIM parcel service on sigejp.pr.gov (crim_parcelas, 'Parcelarios Crim 2018') is stopped (HTTP 500 'not started'). The older satasgis Parcelas endpoints return 404. No other public, queryable Gurabo or island-wide parcel polygon service was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches or the CRIM viewer config. Commercial parcel data exists (Regrid etc.) but is paywalled.
